faqs.q: Sec. 50-73. - Failure to comply; conducting operations without permit.
faqs.a:
(a)
No person shall construct, enlarge, alter, repair, or maintain any grading, excavation,
               or fill, or cause the same to be done, without a site disturbance permit or contrary
               to or in violation of any terms of this chapter or any conditions or requirements
               for an approved site disturbance permit.
(
Ord. No. 4875
, § 1, 8-19-2024)
